description: Pre-execution policy check for an action an agent is about to take: screens the action with Caelara Shield, applies your rules (allowed domains, per-action and daily limits, an approval threshold) and returns allow, deny or require_approval with a verifiable audit receipt; require_approval includes a one-tap approval link. Software policy verdict and audit receipt only: Caelara Labs does not execute, transmit or custody payments or funds. This updates your software policy and receipt. No payment custody is handled by Caelara Labs. (0.005 USDC per call)

action_type.description: What it is trying to do: payment, transfer, purchase, api_call, email, deploy or your own label (max 64 characters)

agent_id.description: Who is acting: your identifier for the agent or bot (max 128 characters)

amount_usd.description: Value of the action in USD

destination.description: Where it goes: URL, domain, address or account label (max 512 characters)

network.description: Rail or chain the action would use: base, ethereum, solana, card, bank, other (max 32 characters)

notify.description: Send approval requests to your linked channels (default true)

payload.description: The action content to screen (string or JSON, max 16 KB)

spent_today_usd.description: Your own figure for today; otherwise an approximate running total of allowed amounts per key and agent is used

name: shield_authorize_action
